name: Publish to Teams
summary: Publishing a BYOM-routed Prompt Agent as a Microsoft Teams app.
description: The Foundry publish-to-Teams flow packages an agent for Microsoft Teams after the agent has been authored in Foundry. The BYOM question is whether an agent whose model is `{connection}/{deployment}` can be published and used in Teams without replacing the orchestrator with a local deployment.
notes:
Not yet covered by a scripted probe; current verification is manual. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/publish-copilot.

Known hard limitation preserved: the SharePoint OBO tool does not work when the agent is published to Teams.
